title: CMMU: A Benchmark for Chinese Multi-modal Multi-type Question Understanding and Reasoning
reasoning: The paper introduces a new benchmark for evaluating multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) in standard academic subjects like math, biology, physics, chemistry, geography, politics, and history. It also discusses 'position bias' as a technical evaluation concern. There is no component focused on evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
